code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pos = {}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: pos.setdefault(v, []).append((r,c))
    frame = max(pos, key=lambda x: len(pos[x]))
    inner = next(x for x in pos if x != frame)
    fr, fc = zip(*pos[frame])
    ir, ic = zip(*pos[inner])
    t = min(min(ir)-min(fr), max(fr)-max(ir), min(ic)-min(fc), max(fc)-max(ic))
    r0,r1=max(0,min(fr)-t),min(h-1,max(fr)+t)
    c0,c1=max(0,min(fc)-t),min(w-1,max(fc)+t)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if grid[r][c] == 0: out[r][c]=inner
    return out
'''
